description: This is a shell script used for testing the output of 'git ls-files' command with various options and formats. It sets up a git repository, adds files with different states, and runs multiple tests to verify the output formatting and behavior of 'git ls-files'.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success with a description and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_expect_code
methods.description: Checks that a command exits with a specific code.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output of commands/files to expected output.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that given output or error streams are empty.
